known_risks: 中文：通过强制 JP v96 中该效果 ID 的全部直接检查来激活语义；PPC 编译器复制/合并的路径数量与 3DS ARM 不完全相同，需要实机逐场景验证。 / English: Activates the semantic effect by forcing every direct JP-v96 check for its effect ID; PPC compiler duplication/consolidation differs from the 3DS ARM build and requires gameplay verification across contexts.

summary: 中文：强制发动“细菌学/Bio Master”相关检查，目标是免疫碎龙黏菌（爆破前状态）与臭气，并提高异臭球驱赶效果及相关调和成功率。 状态：Runtime Experimental，默认关闭。 / English: Forces the Biology/Bio Master checks, intended to prevent Brachydios slimeblight and stench while improving Dung Bomb efficacy and its related combination success. Status: Runtime Experimental; disabled by default.
